name: Full Metal Angel
detailed_description:
Early Access:
This game is in early stages of development. Available game modes include a Time Trial Obstacle Course where you can race to be the best; and a 1v1 PvP Arena game mode where you can battle against your friends.

A gritty, retro-inspired FPS where you pilot a war-torn mech through brutal combat arenas.

This FPS Mech Shooter is a love letter to the legends: Doom, Armored Core 3, and Metroid Prime. It's all about fast-paced movement, chunky firepower, and that satisfying old-school feel — but with a metallic twist.

Right now, you're seeing the foundation: experimental movement systems, core combat mechanics, and a taste of the atmosphere I'm building. The long-term vision? A rogue like Mecha First Person Shooter that blends classic arcade chaos with modern progression, controls, and customization.

Thanks for checking out my game. Your feedback helps shape the metal monster this game is becoming.

short_description: Full Metal Angel is a retro-style FPS Mech shooter where you pilot a customizable war machine, wield up to four weapons, and blast through procedurally generated factories packed with hostile robots. Dodge, dash, and devastate along your path to vengeance in a love letter to old-school shooters.
